title: RideAnalysis
description: Garmin FIT file cycling telemetry analysis output containing summary, gear usage breakdown, and time-series records.

$schema.description: URL link to this schema definition.

start_time.description: UTC timestamp of the start of the ride.

average_power.description: Average power in watts (excluding dropouts/invalid readings).

normalized_power.description: Normalized Power (NP) in watts. Calculated as the 4th root of the average of the 30-second rolling power values raised to the 4th power.

average_heart_rate.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute (bpm).

max_heart_rate.description: Maximum heart rate in beats per minute (bpm).

average_cadence.description: Average cadence in revolutions per minute (rpm) (excluding invalid readings).

max_cadence.description: Maximum cadence in revolutions per minute (rpm).

total_elevation_gain_meters.description: Total accumulated elevation gain in meters.

total_front_shifts.description: Total number of front chainring shifts.

total_rear_shifts.description: Total number of rear cassette shifts.

total_shifts.description: Sum of total front and rear shifts.

theme_name.description: Dynamic visual theme selected for the dashboard, corresponding to the month of the ride (e.g. Classics Flandrian, Giro Pink, Tour Yellow, Vuelta Red, Carbon Dark).

power_curve.description: Mean Maximal Power (MMP) values representing the peak average power sustained for specific durations (e.g., '1s', '30s', '5m').

gear_usage.description: List of gear combinations and their usage durations ordered by most used.

combination.description: The gear combination string represented as 'FrontTeeth x RearTeeth' (e.g., '46x19').

seconds.description: Total duration spent in this gear combination in seconds.

percentage.description: Percentage of total ride time spent in this gear combination.

records.description: Chronological array of telemetry records recorded typically at 1Hz.

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp of this data point.

elapsed_time_seconds.description: Elapsed time since start of ride in seconds.

power.description: Instantaneous power in watts. (Invalid value 65535 is mapped to 0).

heart_rate.description: Heart rate in beats per minute (bpm). (Invalid value 255 is mapped to 0).

cadence.description: Cadence in revolutions per minute (rpm). (Invalid value 255 is mapped to 0).

speed_kmh.description: Current speed in kilometers per hour (km/h).

distance_meters.description: Accumulated distance since start of ride in meters.

front_gear_num.description: 1-based index of the front gear (e.g. 1 = inner chainring, 2 = outer chainring).

front_gear_teeth.description: Teeth count of the front gear (e.g. 33 or 46).

rear_gear_num.description: 1-based index of the rear gear (e.g. 1 = easiest/largest cog, 12 = hardest/smallest cog).

rear_gear_teeth.description: Teeth count of the rear gear (e.g. 10 or 36).

gear_ratio.description: Gear ratio calculated as FrontTeeth / RearTeeth. Represents wheel revolutions per pedal revolution.
